more.def: To make use of something, especially in a practical way.
examples: We utilize every inch of space in our small kitchen.
The farmer utilized a tractor to plow the field.
Students utilize the library for their research.
Safety is of utmost importance.
I did my utmost.
She took the utmost care.

more.def: The greatest possible; as much as you can.
examples: It is of utmost importance that we wear helmets when we ride.
She carried the eggs with the utmost care.
I did my utmost to finish on time.

easy.def: To say or make a sound.
examples: He did not utter a word.
She uttered a cry.
I uttered a sigh.

more.def: To make a sound with your voice, or to speak.
examples: The baby uttered her first word.
She uttered a little cry of surprise.
The baby uttered his first word.
It was utter nonsense.

The room was in utter darkness.
